text:
deploy-bot: scheduled staged rollout v2.14.0 -> 15% traffic in eu-west-1 (canary). bump plan: 15% -> 30% @ +10m unless issues.
elena: starting 10m verification window. watch latency, 5xx, and cpu/mem on model pool.
samir: watching infra metrics now. noted kvcache pressure yesterday, will tail pods.
ops-bot: alert: canary eu-west-1 5xx rate increased to 0.9% (1m avg) vs baseline 0.12%. source: router-proxy.
anya: product: I see a small rerank regression on a sampled eval set, sending details to DM. not severe yet but worth flagging.
mike: oncall: looking at logs, seeing gRPC timeouts from router -> model-worker connections. any recent config flips?
elena: @samir any config or autoscaler changes in the last 2 hours? if infra, we should pin/rollback canary.
samir: no config flips. tailing model-worker-12: OOM killed a process. stack looks like model runtime hit memory spike after quantization kernel change in v2.14.0.
samir: ```
Mar 02 12:04:21 model-worker-12 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (python) score 123
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/serve.py", line 142, in run
MemoryError
```
deploy-bot: scheduled bump to 30% in 8m per plan (no hold instructed).
elena: hold the ramp. don't autoscale up further. decision: revert canary to prior stable if infra fix needed. thoughts?
samir: correlation points to quantization kernel change in 2.14.0 (vQ2). previous stable 2.13.7 uses vQ1 which didn't exhibit OOMs. recommend pinning canary back to v2.13.7 and pausing rollout.
anya: fine from product — quality delta is small and expected; prefer stability. approve pin for canary.
mike: I'll perform the canary rollback/pin and pause the staged rollout. following oncall runbook.
mike: executing: `rcli traffic shift --service inference-eu --from v2.14.0 --to v2.13.7 --percent 15 --target canary`
deploy-bot: traffic shift initiated (job 987654321). operator: mike. ETA ~30s.
deploy-bot: job 987654321 complete. canary now running v2.13.7 @15%.
ops-bot: resolved: 5xx rate down to 0.12% (1m avg). latency back to baseline. :white_check_mark:
elena: good. hold remaining rollouts and mark the release as paused: "paused due to canary infra memory issue; canary rolled back to v2.13.7". I'll update the release ticket and release notes.
anya: leaving canary flagged for a thorough quality regression eval run. if stable for 30m, we can consider a cautious retry with quantization disabled.
samir: we'll provision extra memory headroom on canary pool and add an autoscaler buffer before the next attempt. also adding telemetry for quant kernel memory footprint.
mike: oncall will monitor for 45m and escalate if any recurrence.
elena: thanks everyone. followup: update ticket + schedule a postmortem if the root cause looks like kernel regression. :thumbsup:
